rv.q: But as a whole the work is lacking traction and effective dramaturgy.

A quintet of dancers in mud-spattered, sharp-shouldered white costumes scampers, bickers and fights to the accompaniment of David Preston’s itchy, scratchy soundtrack. A metal bowl is a source of fascination and conflict, and the group determinedly tries to select a sacrificial victim amid a lot of grunting and squealing.
The performances of the works in the programme are very well put together which constitutes an excellent evening of dance.

cn.t: Phoenix Dance Theatre earns acclaim for its emotionally resonant triple bill, with critics praising the company's exploration of human experiences through compelling choreography that ranges from tortured to tender.
